definitions.explanation: The act of cooking rice. Most commonly encountered in the compound {炊飯器|すいはんき} (rice cooker).

examples.japanese: ⟦{炊飯器|すいはんき}→炊飯器：04972_suihanki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧。
examples.english: To cook rice in a rice cooker.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{炊飯器|すいはんき}→炊飯器：04972_suihanki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a new rice cooker.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{炊飯器|すいはんき}→炊飯器：04972_suihanki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧{炊飯|すいはん}⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{炊|た}けている→炊く：02127_taku⟧。
examples.english: This rice cooker has a timed cooking function, so the rice is ready in the morning.

notes:
{炊飯|すいはん} combines {炊|すい} (to cook rice) + {飯|はん} (cooked rice). Almost always encountered in the compound ⟦{炊飯器|すいはんき}→炊飯器：04972_suihanki⟧ (rice cooker). The word {炊飯|すいはん} alone is uncommon in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{炊飯器|すいはんき}→炊飯器：04972_suihanki⟧: rice cooker
- {炊飯|すいはん}⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧: rice cooking function
- {炊飯|すいはん}⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧: timed rice cooking
- {炊飯|すいはん}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: amount of rice to cook

CULTURAL NOTE:
The ⟦{炊飯器|すいはんき}→炊飯器：04972_suihanki⟧ is one of the most essential kitchen appliances in Japan. Modern rice cookers have advanced features like ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧{炊飯|すいはん} (timer cooking) and multiple settings for different rice types.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧: cooked rice / meal
- ⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧: to cook (rice)
- ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧: uncooked rice
